description:
Tour Highlights:

This special narrated cruise voyages through maritime history and passes renowned Boston Harbor landmarks and three-lighthouses of Boston Harbor. This 2-hour cruise will sail past Long Island Light, Graves Light, and Boston Light, America's oldest light station. Narrations and programs on-board provided by staff and volunteers from the National Park Service and United States Coast Guard. ​

As we approach the 250th anniversary of our nation's founding, we are debuting a new Lighthouse Cruise. The 1:00pm Saturday Lighthouse Cruises will focus on the Siege of Boston and its impact on Boston Harbor while continuing to share the history of Boston Light, Long Island Head Light, and Graves Light.

Please Note

- There is no public access to Little Brewster or Boston Light.
- Adverse weather conditions can force cancellations. Please check your email and voicemail before your trip. ​
- There is no food or water available on the boat. - Feel free to bring your own snacks and meals.
- Alcohol, smoking and vaping are prohibited on the boat.
